items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How about Earl Caruthers? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Good. With Lunceford?

ctx.x: You would love them. But the most one you would like most would be Hilton Jefferson. If you was standing in front of Chick and hear this guy play, you would like him. Because I hear Hilton play some things with Cab's band, man, I say, 'Oh (inaudible). He was just something else. Beautiful! Now he used to play Edgar Sampson things and make them come to life, man. He used to make them come to life.
How about Earl Caruthers? He's -- another section (Mafe inaudible) in there. He played baritone mostly, didn't he?
